newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Fleming Overeseas Investment FRN AA.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Fleming Overeseas Investment FRN AA.

text.p: Rating agency Standard & Poor's said it had assigned Fleming Overseas Investment Trust Plc's (Fleming) 80 million stg floating-rate note (FRN) issue a rating of AA.
"The outlook is stable," S&P said in a statement.
"The rating reflects the strong quality and liquid nature of Fleming's assets, low balance sheet gearing, stable performance and the good investment track record and experience of the fund managers."

"The strong quality of assets reflects the risk adverse nature of both thefund managersand Fleming's Board of Directors. This risk aversion also is reflected in the low level of gearing," the agency said.
S&P said the FRN gave Fleming a gearing ratio of approximately 15 percent.

"The investment objective of Fleming is capital growth from overseas markets while its investment policy is to invest in a broad range of overseas markets emphasising those where growth prospects are best. The investment objective and policy provide for good diversification and liquidity of assets, S&P said.
